required_gates.name: duplicate_detection
required_gates.description: No duplicate event_time_utc + raw_identifier within same dataset

required_gates.name: monotonic_timestamps
required_gates.description: Event timestamps must be non-decreasing within each market stream

required_gates.name: invalid_price_detection
required_gates.description: All prices must be positive. OHLC invariants: high >= max(open,close), low <= min(open,close), high >= low

required_gates.name: missing_interval_analysis
required_gates.description: For interval data (candles), flag gaps > expected interval * 1.5

required_gates.name: crossed_book_detection
required_gates.description: L2 book: best_bid must be < best_ask

required_gates.name: mark_index_sanity
required_gates.description: Mark price within 5% of index price (outliers flagged)

required_gates.name: funding_timestamp_sanity
required_gates.description: Funding settlements at expected intervals (1h for HL, 8h for Binance)

required_gates.name: amm_token_order_sanity
required_gates.description: Swap events: token0/token1 order must be consistent with pool contract

required_gates.name: pool_address_identity
required_gates.description: Pool address must match known pool factory + token pair + fee tier

required_gates.name: block_log_uniqueness
required_gates.description: For on-chain events: block_number + log_index must be unique

required_gates.name: replay_determinism
required_gates.description: Collecting the same data twice produces identical raw records (deterministic timestamps)

required_gates.name: normalized_from_raw_determinism
required_gates.description: Normalization of raw data is pure function — same input always produces same output

required_gates.name: future_independence
required_gates.description: Normalization at time T uses only data available at or before T

required_gates.name: schema_validation
required_gates.description: Every record validates against its registered schema

required_gates.name: source_outage_classification
required_gates.description: Extended gaps (>1h for perps, >1 block for on-chain) classified as SOURCE_OUTAGE not data corruption
